description: Adversaries attempt to enumerate accessible services and ports across remote network endpoints to map vulnerabilities before exploitation.
mitigation: Drop scanning packets immediately, enforce rate-limiting on TCP SYN requests, and blacklist the offending source IP at the edge firewall.

description: Adversaries direct high-volume traffic floods (SYN/UDP floods) towards internal hosts to degrade network availability and exhaust socket memory buffers.
mitigation: Enable SYN cookies, activate edge scrubbing center redirect, and enforce per-IP packet rate limits at the router gateway.

description: Anomalous communication bursts across non-standard application protocols indicating lateral movement or unauthorized internal scanning.
mitigation: Quarantine the internal subnet, inspect active session state tables, and terminate persistent TCP connections.
